summary: The ordinary /api/teaching/gradebook-updates/[objectId]/rollback POST route now rejects signed teacher cookies whose actorId or sessionId is not a safe server identity before gradebook release rollback writes can run.

redGreenEvidence.observed: The unsafe gradebook rollback actorId case failed with HTTP 500 because the validly signed unsafe actorId reached later ownership lookup. The unsafe gradebook rollback sessionId case failed with HTTP 200 because the validly signed unsafe sessionId allowed a release rollback write.

redGreenEvidence.command: ./node_modules/.bin/vitest run tests/teaching-operation-backend.test.ts --reporter=dot -t "unsafe signed gradebook rollback|lets the owning teacher roll back a released gradebook update"

behaviorHardened: Signed gradebook rollback cookies whose actorId fails the safe-id boundary now resolve as unauthenticated and return HTTP 401 with authenticated-session-required.
Signed gradebook rollback cookies whose sessionId fails the safe-id boundary now resolve as unauthenticated and return HTTP 401 with authenticated-session-required.
Unsafe signed identity claims are rejected before gradebook release rollback projections, rollback notifications, or teaching-gradebook-update.release-rolled-back audit events can be written.
The denial response preserves trace id and redaction without echoing unsafe local-path or secret-like identity values.
